name: Ms. Nonsense
greeting: Pay attention. I will not repeat myself twice in one century.

topics.label: Ask about town history
topics.line: What's the real history of this town?
topics.goodText: "I'm not telling you this because I like you." She tells you about the winter the records skip.

topics.label: Compliment her teaching
topics.line: Your lectures are actually really good.
topics.goodText: "Obviously." But she stands a little straighter.
topics.badText: "Whatever you want, the answer is no." She thinks you're angling to skip an assignment.

misheard.line: Your lectures are actually really... long.

topics.label: Ask directly about the Upside-Down
topics.line: I know about the Upside-Down. You do too.
topics.goodText: A long silence. Then a dense, reluctant, furious lore dump.

topics.label: Apologize for something
topics.goodText: She doesn't forgive easily. She does notice.

topics.label: Ask about Sam and Baxter
topics.line: Do Sam and Baxter ever get caught?
topics.goodText: "Those two think I don't notice. I notice. I simply have better things to do than prove it."

topics.label: Ask about Todd
topics.goodText: "Todd missed another exam. I've stopped asking why. The excuse notes have gotten *creative*."

gifts.likeText: "Correct citations." The closest she gets to a smile.
